title: Silent Night, Holy Night
lyrics: [C]Silent night! holy night! [G]All is calm, [C]All is bright
[C]Silent night! holy night! [G]Shepherds quake [C]at the sight,
[G]Christ the Saviour is [C]born! Christ the [G]saviour is [C]born.
[C]Silent night! holy night! [G]Son of God, [C]love's pure light
[G]Jesus Lord at thy [C]birth, Jesus [G]Lord at thy [C]birth.
